parameters.query:
-- Build filtered query
WITH params AS (SELECT '{{ $json["filters"] }}'::jsonb AS f, ({{ $json["limit"] }} )::int AS limit_val, ({{ $json["offset"] }})::int AS offset_val)
SELECT p.id, p.display_name AS name, p.age, p.city, p.avatar_file_id, p.description
FROM profiles p, params
WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ( (params.f->>'city' IS NULL OR params.f->>'city' = '') OR p.city = params.f->>'city')
  AND ( (params.f->>'age_from' IS NULL OR params.f->>'age_from' = '') OR p.age >= (params.f->>'age_from')::int)
  AND ( (params.f->>'age_to' IS NULL OR params.f->>'age_to' = '') OR p.age <= (params.f->>'age_to')::int)
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
LIMIT (SELECT limit_val FROM params)
OFFSET (SELECT offset_val FROM params);

-- total count for pagination
WITH params AS (SELECT '{{ $json["filters"] }}'::jsonb AS f)
SELECT count(*) AS total FROM profiles p, params
WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ( (params.f->>'city' IS NULL OR params.f->>'city' = '') OR p.city = params.f->>'city')
  AND ( (params.f->>'age_from' IS NULL OR params.f->>'age_from' = '') OR p.age >= (params.f->>'age_from')::int)
  AND ( (params.f->>'age_to' IS NULL OR params.f->>'age_to' = '') OR p.age <= (params.f->>'age_to')::int);
